column3: In the end, both sides decided not to give in and have a real match.
No matter who the opponent is, what we must do doesn't change.
Even if she said that, their ability is obviously superior to ours...
Kuroneko's virtuoso skill may be covering me, I still lack any gaming skill.
This will certainly be a tough battle.
And they know full well the extent of my skills...
The two of them will probably gang up on me.
Since we know each others' strengths, it's given that they will focus their attacks on me.
On the other hand, aren't we also able to predict their movements?
Kuroneko... I believe we might possibly win this battle.
And thus the big battle between the four of us began--
When the match started, Kirino and Saori both focused their attacks on me as predicted.
A-Although I knew about it, their onslaught is fiercer than I thought...
I might not be able to last for the entire 60 seconds...
Kyousuke-shi! Nobody's going to find your corpse!
Since they usually get along, they are able to cooperate...!
Kyousuke-shi, I won't let you do it!
Kuroneko gives me precise advice while she closely follows Saori's and Kirino's characters.
It's like she's controlling both characters at the same time.
But in reality, I'm still the one who has to control mine.
Kirino inputs a complicated command on her controller, and at that very moment--
Just one minute. Did you have a bad dream?
YOU WIN!! flashes on the screen.
Kirino blankly stared at the screen with dumbfounded eyes.
No, I didn't really expect to win as well.
I knew that your sister would use this technique as a final blow.
She wanted to win using her most flashy technique in front of the large audience. This is the way of that attention-seeking girl.
Well well, that was certainly a close game.
Hey hey, Kirino, don't pressure us.
No way, a complete victory! I won't accept anything else.
Be that as it may, miracles don't occur that often. Above all, we'll meet powerful opponents that were able to advance to the finals.
After getting so far, we have no choice but to do it!
